result.summary: ISS-0151 root-caused and fixed. Both hypotheses named in the handoff were refuted by measurement: the 23505 is TC-TNT-02-05's deliberate assertion (constant 1/run on passing runs), and the ISS-0148 blocking sweep was not implicated (zero ungranted locks and zero advisory locks held during live hangs). Actual cause: commit db362fd (GH-402) deleted all three pg_advisory_lock acquires from tests/integration/helpers.zig but left the matching pg_advisory_unlock in TestHarness.init(), so since 2026-08-03 the harness released a lock nobody took and concurrent test binaries ran migration check-and-apply unguarded. test-integration-tnt runs two binaries concurrently, both bootstrapping through helpers.zig against shared public/tenant_default - each is green alone, flaky together. The two observed symptoms (tnt_backfill ~60s runner timeout; tnt_schema_isolation 42P01 on events_archive/events/instance_projections from runForSchema) are one cause. Restored all three acquires, each bracketed with the proven ISS-0107-rework-1 lock_timeout pattern, released via defer. Post-fix: 5 consecutive runs exit 0,0,0,0,0 (plus 6 more before that, 11 total consecutive passes); 8/8 steps, 34/34 tests passed; all-42P01 count 0; ISS-0148's audit_entries signature still 0. ISS-0148's ordering edge and advisory-locked sweep untouched.
result.next_action: Return to ORCH. ISS-0151 DRAINED; GH #477's deterministic-5-run criterion is now met, unblocking #477. Remaining queue items: ISS-0150 (GH #482), ISS-0152 (GH #484).
